title: Network
subtitle: Find people, expertise, and opportunities for what you are building right now.
investmentNotice: The Network supports introductions. It does not broker investments or provide investment advice.

empty.title: No listing currently meets every selected criterion.
empty.text: Reset the filters or make your own current need or contribution concrete.

form.direction: What would you like to do?
form.title: Short title
form.summaryHint: Be specific about the need or offer and what would make a useful connection.
form.topicsHint: Separate with commas, up to {max}. E.g. B2B sales, product strategy, software development, fundraising.
form.industriesHint: Separate with commas, up to {max}. E.g. HealthTech, SaaS, ClimateTech, Future of Work.
form.locationsHint: Separate with commas, up to {max}. E.g. Berlin, Brandenburg.
form.scopeHint: Describes geographic relevance independently of remote work.
form.startsOnHint: Optional. When does the content become relevant?
form.endsOnHint: Optional. With no end date, the timeframe remains flexible.

create.kindText: Choose a category. Co-Founder search remains a dedicated, deeper workflow.

cofounder.title: Co-Founder search
cofounder.text: Co-Founder search has its own area. It lets you consider experience and practical constraints alongside expectations about working together.
cofounder.cta: Set up or view Co-Founder search

detail.what: What is being sought or offered?

contact.title: Contacts
contact.text: Review requests and continue accepted contacts in a private internal exchange.
contact.messageLabel: Why would you like to get in touch?
contact.messageHint: Briefly explain what you would like to discuss and why an exchange could be useful. 10–500 characters.
contact.error: The contact request could not be updated.

statusText.pending: The recipient will decide about your request.
statusText.accepted: You both agreed to get in touch and can continue the exchange here.

messages.emptyText: You have accepted the contact. Write a first message when you would like to start the exchange.
messages.error: The message could not be sent. Please check the text.

profile.title: Your Network profile
profile.text: You explicitly choose the compact identity other members can see. Private profile, Discovery, and assessment data remain separate.
profile.reuseText: You can copy suitable details from your existing CoFoundery profile into an unpublished draft, then review them before publishing.
profile.reused: Details copied into a draft. Review them and publish explicitly.
profile.name: Display name
profile.headline: Headline
profile.rolesHint: These roles only describe you in the Network and never change permissions.
profile.consent: “Publish Network profile” makes these details visible to signed-in Network members. Listings follow their own member contract, messages stay private, and blocking and reporting are available.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.helper: Your profile photo appears inside CoFoundery on your Network profile and Network listings.
photo.platformOnlyHint: Only signed-in, active Network members can retrieve this image.
photo.publicAllowed: May also appear on public CoFoundery pages
photo.publicAllowedHint: This is a preference only. Your photo appears publicly only if you later explicitly publish a profile or listing publicly.

safety.blockConfirm: This person will no longer be able to send you new Network requests or messages. Continue?
safety.blockedState: New Network requests and messages are currently disabled between you.
safety.chatStopped: The existing history remains visible. No new messages can be sent while a block is active.
safety.reportError: The report could not be saved.

success.reported: Thank you. The report was stored confidentially and will be reviewed.

errors.incomplete: Complete the required information before publishing.
errors.save: Could not save. Please check your details.
errors.reuse: Existing details could not be reused.
errors.photo_reuse: The existing profile image could not be copied securely.
errors.photo_upload: The image could not be saved. Use JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB.
errors.too_many_topics: Please enter no more than 8 topics or areas of expertise.
errors.too_many_industries: Please enter no more than 5 industries or topics.
errors.too_many_locations: Please enter no more than 3 locations or regions.
errors.invalid_dates: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.message: Please write a message between 10 and 500 characters.
errors.contact_profile: Publish your Network profile first so the recipient knows who is getting in touch.
errors.contact_unavailable: A new contact request cannot be sent for this listing right now.
errors.contact_self: You cannot send a contact request to yourself.
errors.contact: The contact request could not be sent.
